title: Presentation my game project CONQUEROR: Ashes of the Third War
author: Koss-Game-Studio
selftext:
Discover **CONQUEROR: Ashes of the Third War**, a project by **Koss Game Studios** combining turn-based strategy, resource management, and logistics on an Earth transformed by war.

This video introduces the concept and early development of the game. The project is still in its initial stages, and the rest of the map, world, nations, and factions will be added as development progresses.

**Everything shown is a work in progress and subject to change.** The interface and HUD, artwork, units, mechanics, and balancing are still being developed. This footage reflects the project’s current state and intended direction, rather than its final appearance or gameplay.

This is a first glimpse of what we want CONQUEROR to become—and an invitation to watch it take shape.

**Follow Koss Game Studios and join us on this journey.**
